read_replica_scene_info: read a Replica dataset folder and return a SceneInfo object with cameras, point cloud, and train/valid splits
get_replica_intrinsics: get the fixed camera intrinsic parameters (fx, fy, cx, cy) for the Replica dataset
load_replica_poses: load camera poses from a Replica dataset traj.txt file and convert them to Camera objects
build_replica_camera_list: build a list of Camera objects from Replica RGB images, depth maps, and camera trajectory data
split_replica_train_valid: split Replica dataset cameras into train and validation sets using OmniSeg3D-style indexing
